title: Vanderbilt TSSA 范德堡大學臺灣同學會
content_html:
Vanderbilt TSSA (范德堡大學臺灣同學會) is a Facebook group associated with Taiwanese students and alumni at Vanderbilt University. Its Chinese name translates to ‘Vanderbilt University Taiwanese Student Association.’ The group’s web presence is limited to a single Facebook group page; no description, membership count, or activity level could be confirmed from publicly accessible content.

TSSA does not appear in Vanderbilt’s official Anchor Link student organization registry or in the SCBC advised organizations directory, which lists TASA as the campus’s registered Taiwanese student group. Whether TSSA functions as an informal social network, a graduate student group, or a dormant organization could not be determined from available first-party sources.
